description: Ministry of Finance Economic and Policy Development - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2152/32 of 15.12.2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains an order under Section 3 of the Act that modifies tariff schedules and concessionary rates for specific imported goods. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, the focus is on the regulatory amendment rather than personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content centers on legal authority, statutory instruments, and regulatory changes to import duties, fitting squarely within the Legal/Regulatory classification.
